speaker: john_heminges
text: Set it down there. No, on the cloth, Will, on the cloth, I'll not chase an angel under the settle. A warrant has no weight until someone brings the coin. You've brought it. So. Twenty pound. Count it with me, somebody honest.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Count it with me. I'm first on the Queen's paper. William Kemp, William Shakespeare and Richard Burbage. I heard the clerk read it. He read me loudest.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He read you first because he began at the wrong end and was too proud to turn about. And we stood an hour in his passage while he trimmed his quills.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He read us as servants to the Lord Chamberlain, all three, and looked at us as a man looks at three fish. I never felt so paid and so little.

speaker: james_burbage
text: What's the date on it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whitehall, the fifteenth of March, fifteen ninety-four.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Ninety-four! There. We played at Christmas, they pay us in Lent, and they date it a year gone. That's the Queen's arithmetic. But I'm first on it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It's ninety-four till Lady Day, as you well know, and it's twenty pound in any year. Sixteen angels at ten shillings, that's eight pound. Four sovereigns, twelve. And eight pound in white money, shillings and sixpences. Twenty, sound and unclipped.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: That makes twenty, even when spoken slowly.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And Alleyn's crew had thirty for three nights at Greenwich. Next Christmas we play three, or I eat my buskins.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them have their thirty, Dick. They'll spend it on elm boards. Henslowe has carpenters coming in on Monday.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirteen, six and eight for the two plays. Six, thirteen and four of Her Majesty's reward. Now. Item.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Here it comes. Hide your purses, lads, John has said Item.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, boat-hire to Greenwich and home, two days, and the carriage of the baskets. Sixteen shillings.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sixteen! Did we go by way of Calais?

speaker: john_heminges
text: We went against the tide, at Christmas, with a dog. Item, rewards. Five hired men at four shillings. Three boys at two. The book-keeper and the tireman, four apiece. Thirty-four shillings.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Give the boys three, John. Nick stood two hours in that farthingale and never once scratched.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two is written. I'll give them the third in pies, and it'll please them better. Item. The— the mercer in Cheapside. For the taffeta, and the copper lace, and the Princess's gown that is still not paid for. Fifty shillings.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Fifty shillings on a gown for a play the Queen's never seen!

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The town has seen it three times, Will. You were in it. You spoke five-and-thirty lines more than I wrote, and a whole song, and I've put nine of them in the book.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Only nine?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The rest were about the gown.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Sixteen, thirty-four and fifty. That is five pound, to the penny. Which leaves fifteen. Fifteen pound in eight parts is thirty-seven shillings and sixpence the part.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Eight parts. I count seven men at this board. Who's the eighth, the dog?

speaker: john_heminges
text: The stock. As always. The apparel, the books, the licence money. The stock takes a share and I keep it, and when your motley splits, Will Kemp, the stock will buy you another.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then let the stock pay Mistress Kettlewood first. She's owed for a prince's sleeves since the autumn, and she looks at me in the tiring-house as if I wore them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thursday. Out of the stock. Eight shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight shillings. She required me to remember it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sensible woman.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I say this. The Queen's reward, the six, thirteen and four, that's a reward for pleasing. Who pleased? When her ladies were nodding on Innocents' night and the candles guttered, who gave them the jig and woke the whole Presence? I say the reward goes by desert.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: By desert! God's my life. Then give it all to the dog.

speaker: james_burbage
text: By desert I'd have the rent of my house out of it before any of you saw a groat. Who keeps a roof over this company? And two years left on the ground, and Giles Allen sniffing at my timber…

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Father. Not the lease. Not before dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Will, hear me. If we pay by desert we must first agree what each man deserves, and we shall be here till Easter and come out with nothing but opinions. Pay it by the share and we'll all go to dinner equally wronged.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Equally wronged! Write that over the door.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You've a smooth tongue, Master Shakespeare. I've noted it. It goes round a man like a cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's my whole living. I have no dog.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Take your thirty-seven and six, Will, and I'll set you a new jig for Easter, and you shall have the whole stage after the play and nobody's lines to trouble you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: …With the slippers?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: With the slippers.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Hm. Well. Count it out, then. But I was first on the paper.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You were first on the paper. I'll write that in the book, if it will content you. Kemp. First on the paper. Thirty-seven and six. Richard. Thirty-seven and six. Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thank you, John. …It's lighter than I thought the Queen would be.

speaker: will_kemp
text: John, you will never be troubled by a false report from your own mouth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am troubled sufficiently by the rest of yours.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Come to the Bull and drink the Queen's health, all of you. Lent or no Lent.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One cup. Mistress Ansell can smell a tavern through two oak doors, and she has opinions on sack in Lent.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And what will you do with the rest of yours?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put it on a horse.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: A wager? You?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A hired one. As far as Warwickshire. I'm going home for Lent, and I mean to arrive like a man who has been paid.

speaker: james_burbage
text: And come back, mind. Easter Monday. There's a house to open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll come back. I've a king wants writing, and nowhere in Stratford to put him.
